ideas.title: The Automation Audit
ideas.concept: A real client audit post showing a before/after workflow transformation. BEFORE: 14 browser tabs, sticky notes everywhere, leads sitting 3+ days with no follow-up, manual invoicing across 4 spreadsheets, 'I'll remember it' calendar system. AFTER: Centralised Google Workspace hub, GoHighLevel pipeline auto-nurturing leads, Claude AI handling repetitive comms, 60%+ admin time cut in 7 days. Facebook layout: left column has headline/badge/CTA/logo, right panel MUST be fully populated showing the AFTER results as a styled stat/list panel — never empty. CTA MUST be 'Still selling manually?' — do not use 'Sound familiar?'.
